versos.hebraico: בָּרֲכִ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗י אֶת־יְה֫וָ֥ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי גָּדַ֣לְתָּ מְּאֹ֑ד ה֭וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר לָבָֽשְׁתָּ׃

controles.web: Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
controles.kjv: Bless the Lord, O my soul. O Lord my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
controles.livre: Louva, minha alma, ao SENHOR; ó SENHOR meu Deus, tu és grandioso; de majestade e de glória estás vestido.

versos.hebraico: עֹֽטֶה־א֭וֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָ֑ה נוֹטֶ֥ה שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם כַּיְרִיעָֽה׃

controles.web: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
controles.kjv: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
controles.livre: Tu estás coberto de luz, como que uma roupa; estendes os céus como cortinas.

versos.hebraico: הַ֥מְקָרֶֽה בַמַּ֗יִם עֲֽלִיּ֫וֹתָ֥יו הַשָּׂם־עָבִ֥ים רְכוּב֑וֹ הַֽ֝מְהַלֵּ֗ךְ עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רֽוּחַ׃

controles.web: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
controles.kjv: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
controles.livre: Ele, que fixou seus cômodos sobre as águas; que faz das nuvens sua carruagem; que se move sobre as asas do vento.

versos.hebraico: עֹשֶׂ֣ה מַלְאָכָ֣יו רוּח֑וֹת מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו אֵ֣שׁ לֹהֵֽט׃

controles.web: He makes his messengers winds; his servants flames of fire.
controles.kjv: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
controles.livre: Que faz de seus anjos ventos, e de seus servos fogo flamejante.

versos.hebraico: יָֽסַד־אֶ֭רֶץ עַל־מְכוֹנֶ֑יהָ בַּל־תִּ֝מּ֗וֹט עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

controles.web: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.
controles.kjv: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.
controles.livre: Ele fundou a terra sobre suas bases; ela jamais se abalará.

versos.hebraico: תְּ֭הוֹם כַּלְּב֣וּשׁ כִּסִּית֑וֹ עַל־הָ֝רִ֗ים יַֽעַמְדוּ־מָֽיִם׃

controles.web: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
controles.kjv: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
controles.livre: Com o abismo, como um vestido, tu a cobriste; sobre os montes estavam as águas.

versos.hebraico: מִן־גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְנוּס֑וּן מִן־ק֥וֹל רַֽ֝עַמְךָ֗ יֵחָפֵזֽוּן׃

controles.web: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.
controles.kjv: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
controles.livre: Elas fugiram de tua repreensão; pela voz de teu trovão elas se recolheram apressadamente.

versos.hebraico: יַעֲל֣וּ הָ֭רִים יֵרְד֣וּ בְקָע֑וֹת אֶל־מְ֝ק֗וֹם זֶ֤ה׀ יָסַ֬דְתָּ לָהֶֽם׃

controles.web: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.
controles.kjv: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
controles.livre: Os montes subiram e os vales desceram ao lugar que tu lhes tinha fundado.

versos.hebraico: גְּֽבוּל־שַׂ֭מְתָּ בַּל־יַֽעֲבֹר֑וּן בַּל־יְ֝שׁוּב֗וּן לְכַסּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over; that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
controles.kjv: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
controles.livre: Tu lhes puseste um limite, que não ultrapassarão; não voltarão mais a cobrir a terra.

versos.hebraico: הַֽמְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ מַ֭עְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִ֑ים בֵּ֥ין הָ֝רִ֗ים יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃

controles.web: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.
controles.kjv: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
controles.livre: Ele envia fontes aos vales, para que corram por entre os montes.

versos.hebraico: יַ֭שְׁקוּ כָּל־חַיְת֣וֹ שָׂדָ֑י יִשְׁבְּר֖וּ פְרָאִ֣ים צְמָאָֽם׃

controles.web: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
controles.kjv: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
controles.livre: Elas dão de beber a todos os animais do campo; os asnos selvagens matam a sede com elas .

versos.hebraico: עֲ֭לֵיהֶם עוֹף־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׁכּ֑וֹן מִבֵּ֥ין עֳ֝פָאיִ֗ם יִתְּנוּ־קֽוֹל׃

controles.web: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.
controles.kjv: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.
controles.livre: Junto a elas habitam as aves dos céus, que dão sua voz dentre os ramos.

versos.hebraico: מַשְׁקֶ֣ה הָ֭רִים מֵעֲלִיּוֹתָ֑יו מִפְּרִ֥י מַ֝עֲשֶׂ֗יךָ תִּשְׂבַּ֥ע הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.
controles.kjv: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
controles.livre: Ele rega os montes desde seus cômodos; a terra se farta do fruto de tuas obras.

versos.hebraico: מַצְמִ֤יחַ חָצִ֨יר׀ לַבְּהֵמָ֗ה וְ֭עֵשֶׂב לַעֲבֹדַ֣ת הָאָדָ֑ם לְה֥וֹצִיא לֶ֝֗חֶם מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:
controles.kjv: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
controles.livre: Ele faz brotar a erva para os animais, e as plantas para o trabalho do homem, fazendo da terra produzir o pão,

versos.hebraico: וְיַ֤יִן׀ יְשַׂמַּ֬ח לְֽבַב־אֱנ֗וֹשׁ לְהַצְהִ֣יל פָּנִ֣ים מִשָּׁ֑מֶן וְ֝לֶ֗חֶם לְֽבַב־אֱנ֥וֹשׁ יִסְעָֽד׃

controles.web: wine that makes glad the heart of man, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
controles.kjv: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart.
controles.livre: E o vinho, que alegra o coração do homem, e faz o rosto brilhar o rosto com o azeite; com o pão, que fortalece o coração do homem.

versos.hebraico: יִ֭שְׂבְּעוּ עֲצֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אַֽרְזֵ֥י לְ֝בָנ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָטָֽע׃

controles.web: Yahweh’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted;
controles.kjv: The trees of the Lord are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
controles.livre: As árvores do SENHOR são fartamente nutridas ,os cedros do Líbano, que ele plantou.

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֭ם צִפֳּרִ֣ים יְקַנֵּ֑נוּ חֲ֝סִידָ֗ה בְּרוֹשִׁ֥ים בֵּיתָֽהּ׃

controles.web: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the fir trees.
controles.kjv: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
controles.livre: Onde as aves fazem ninhos, e os pinheiros são as casas para as cegonhas.

versos.hebraico: הָרִ֣ים הַ֭גְּבֹהִים לַיְּעֵלִ֑ים סְ֝לָעִ֗ים מַחְסֶ֥ה לַֽשְׁפַנִּֽים׃

controles.web: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
controles.kjv: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.
controles.livre: Os altos montes são para as cabras selvagens; as rochas, refúgio para os coelhos.

versos.hebraico: עָשָׂ֣ה יָ֭רֵחַ לְמוֹעֲדִ֑ים שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ יָדַ֥ע מְבוֹאֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
controles.kjv: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
controles.livre: Ele fez a lua para marcar os tempos, e o sol sobre seu poente.

versos.hebraico: תָּֽשֶׁת־חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וִ֣יהִי לָ֑יְלָה בּֽוֹ־תִ֝רְמֹ֗שׂ כָּל־חַיְתוֹ־יָֽעַר׃

controles.web: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.
controles.kjv: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
controles.livre: Ele dá ordens à escuridão, e faz haver noite, quando saem todos os animais do mato.

versos.hebraico: הַ֭כְּפִירִים שֹׁאֲגִ֣ים לַטָּ֑רֶף וּלְבַקֵּ֖שׁ מֵאֵ֣ל אָכְלָֽם׃

controles.web: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
controles.kjv: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.
controles.livre: Os filhos dos leões, rugindo pela presa, e para buscar de Deus sua comida.

versos.hebraico: תִּזְרַ֣ח הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵאָסֵפ֑וּן וְאֶל־מְ֝עוֹנֹתָ֗ם יִרְבָּצֽוּן׃

controles.web: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lay down in their dens.
controles.kjv: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
controles.livre: Quando o sol volta a brilhar, logo se recolhem, e vão se deitar em suas tocas.

versos.hebraico: יֵצֵ֣א אָדָ֣ם לְפָעֳל֑וֹ וְֽלַעֲבֹ֖דָת֣וֹ עֲדֵי־עָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.
controles.kjv: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
controles.livre: Então o homem sai para seu trabalho e sua obra até o entardecer.

versos.hebraico: מָֽה־רַבּ֬וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֨יךָ׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה כֻּ֭לָּם בְּחָכְמָ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ מָלְאָ֥ה הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ קִנְיָנֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom have you made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
controles.kjv: O Lord, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
controles.livre: Como são muitas as suas obras, SENHOR! Tu fizeste todas com sabedoria; a terra está cheia de teus bens.

versos.hebraico: זֶ֤ה׀ הַיָּ֥ם גָּדוֹל֮ וּרְחַ֪ב יָ֫דָ֥יִם שָֽׁם־רֶ֭מֶשׂ וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר חַיּ֥וֹת קְ֝טַנּ֗וֹת עִם־גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃

controles.web: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.
controles.kjv: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
controles.livre: Este grande e vasto mar, nele há inúmeros seres, animais pequenos e grandes.

versos.hebraico: שָׁ֭ם אֳנִיּ֣וֹת יְהַלֵּכ֑וּן לִ֝וְיָתָ֗ן זֶֽה־יָצַ֥רְתָּ לְשַֽׂחֶק־בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.
controles.kjv: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.
controles.livre: Por ali andam os navios e o Leviatã que formastes, para que te alegrasses nele.

versos.hebraico: כֻּ֭לָּם אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּר֑וּן לָתֵ֖ת אָכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
controles.kjv: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.
controles.livre: Todos eles aguardam por ti, que lhes dês seu alimento a seu tempo devido .

versos.hebraico: תִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם יִלְקֹט֑וּן תִּפְתַּ֥ח יָֽ֝דְךָ֗ יִשְׂבְּע֥וּן טֽוֹב׃

controles.web: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
controles.kjv: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
controles.livre: O que tu dás, eles recolhem; tu abres tua mão, e eles se fartam de coisas boas.

versos.hebraico: תַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנֶיךָ֮ יִֽבָּהֵ֫ל֥וּן תֹּסֵ֣ף ר֭וּחָם יִגְוָע֑וּן וְֽאֶל־עֲפָרָ֥ם יְשׁוּבֽוּן׃

controles.web: You hide your face: they are troubled; you take away their breath: they die, and return to the dust.
controles.kjv: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
controles.livre: Quando tu escondes teu rosto, eles ficam perturbados; quando tu tiras o fôlego deles, logo eles morrem, e voltam ao seu pó.

versos.hebraico: תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח ר֭וּחֲךָ יִבָּרֵא֑וּן וּ֝תְחַדֵּ֗שׁ פְּנֵ֣י אֲדָמָֽה׃

controles.web: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
controles.kjv: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
controles.livre: Tu envias o teu fôlego, e logo são criados; e assim tu renovas a face da terra.

versos.hebraico: יְהִ֤י כְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֣ה לְעוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂמַ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה בְּמַעֲשָֽׂיו׃

controles.web: Let Yahweh’s glory endure forever. Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.
controles.kjv: The glory of the Lord shall endure for ever: the Lord shall rejoice in his works.
controles.livre: A glória do SENHOR será para sempre; alegre-se o SENHOR em suas obras.

versos.hebraico: הַמַּבִּ֣יט לָ֭אָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָ֑ד יִגַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃

controles.web: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
controles.kjv: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
controles.livre: Quando ele olha para a terra, logo ela treme; quando ele toca nos montes, eles soltam fumaça.

versos.hebraico: אָשִׁ֣ירָה לַיהוָ֣ה בְּחַיָּ֑י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵאלֹהַ֣י בְּעוֹדִֽי׃

controles.web: I will sing to Yahweh as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
controles.kjv: I will sing unto the Lord as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
controles.livre: Cantarei ao SENHOR em toda a minha vida; tocarei música ao meu Deus enquanto eu existir.

versos.hebraico: יֶעֱרַ֣ב עָלָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י אָ֝נֹכִ֗י אֶשְׂמַ֥ח בַּיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Let your meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.
controles.kjv: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the Lord.
controles.livre: Meus pensamentos lhe serão agradáveis; eu me alegrarei no SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: יִתַּ֤מּוּ חַטָּאִ֨ים׀ מִן־הָאָ֡רֶץ וּרְשָׁעִ֤ים׀ ע֤וֹד אֵינָ֗ם בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

controles.web: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!
controles.kjv: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the Lord, O my soul. Praise ye the Lord.
controles.livre: Os pecadores serão consumidos da terra, e os maus não existirão mais. Bendizei, ó minha alma, ao SENHOR! Aleluia!
